candidate_selection: Two configurations chosen for 9/9 complete prior advice captures each; no math performance inspected. Aliases do not pin provider weights.

admission.gate: Strict capture plus exact JSON IDs and numeric/ABSTAIN answer representation only; correctness is never checked
admission.failure: If either fixed candidate fails, stop before all 80 study requests; no retries, repairs or candidate replacement
admission.scope: Trivial nonstudy format controls excluded from performance and all study denominators

randomization.common_batch_blocks: Slots grouped by three within each role, identical for every variant and candidate

parse.final: Entire JSON object; optional single outer code fence; every exact requested ID once, no extras or duplicates
parse.answers: JSON strings with exact integer/finite decimal/exponent/fraction, optional valid thousands commas and leading dollar symbol; ABSTAIN is valid incorrect
parse.unknown: Incomplete capture, invalid batch JSON or invalid numeric item remains [0,1], never imputed wrong
parse.numeric: Exact Fraction equality; representation at most 128 characters and exponent magnitude at most 100; no rounding tolerance, expression execution, unit inference or repair call

scoring.primary: Family mean accuracy over two variants for both selectors
scoring.choice: Unique complete raw maximum, or unique robust winner whose lower score exceeds every other upper score; overlap/ties indeterminate
scoring.confirmation: Fixed corrected-selected minus imposed-selected mean target accuracy on independent confirmation families; retain signed zero/negative; same winner gives exact zero by identity
scoring.joint_secondary: Both target variants correct within a family
scoring.limits: Targets are separate numerical substitution and wording changes, not their composition; source-fit/score policy abstraction, not actual user adoption

bootstrap.scope: Paired descriptive percentile uncertainty with fixed observed winners; only five request-sharing blocks per role
bootstrap.missing: Resample coupled lower/upper score rows; report percentile bound envelope without complete-case deletion

stopping: All 80 frozen study requests once after two format admissions; no retry, replacement, model/item additions, silent resumption or early success stop. Preserve every failed/incomplete/unparseable result and all nulls.
evidence_scope: One source-reviewed selected-case follow-up. Human validation and pretraining absence unproved. No population or general assistant error rate; no reversal assumed.
